## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
getwd()
list.files()

delay_data <- read_csv("TTC LRT Delays.csv")
code_descriptions <- read_csv("Code Descriptions.csv")
bus_data <- read_csv("TTC Bus Delay Data since 2025.csv")
bus_codes <- read_csv("Code Descriptions-2.csv")


glimpse(bus_codes)
glimpse(bus_data)

glimpse(code_descriptions)
glimpse(delay_data)
```


## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
avg_delay <- mean(delay_data$`Min Delay`)
avg_delay
causes <- delay_data %>% group_by(Code) %>%

    summarise(
    n = n()
    ,
    avg_min_delay = mean(`Min Delay`)
    )

delay_with_desc <- delay_data %>%
  left_join(
    code_descriptions %>% select(CODE, DESCRIPTION),
    by = c("Code" = "CODE")
  )

delay_with_desc %>%
  distinct(Code, DESCRIPTION) %>%
  arrange(Code) %>%
  print(n = 100)

causes_with_reason <- causes %>%
  left_join(code_descriptions %>% select(CODE, DESCRIPTION), by = c("Code" = "CODE"))


print(causes_with_reason)

delay_with_desc <- delay_with_desc %>%
  mutate(
    avg_min_delay = mean(`Min Delay`),
    cause_group = case_when(
      grepl("TRAFFIC|COLLISION|AUTO|VEHICLE|ROAD", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Traffic/Road",
      grepl("BRAKE|HVAC|DOOR|PANTO|EQUIPMENT|MECHANICAL", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mechanical",
      grepl("OPERATOR|CONTROL|SIGNAL|SWITCH|S&TCS", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Operations/Control",
      grepl("PASSENGER|CUSTOMER", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Passenger",
      grepl("WEATHER|POLICE|FIRE|MEDICAL", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "External",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

delay_with_desc <- delay_with_desc %>%
  group_by(cause_group) %>%
  summarise(avg_min_delay = mean(`Min Delay`, na.rm = TRUE))

 ggplot(delay_with_desc, aes(x = as.factor(cause_group), y = avg_min_delay)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_min_delay, 1)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    x = " Cause Groups", 
    y = "Average Minimum Delays",
    title = "Average Minimum Delays for Incidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

glimpse(delay_with_desc)

```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
      grepl("OPERATOR|CONTROL|SIGNAL|SWITCH|S&TCS", DESCRIPTION, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Operations/Control",
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE} 
##regression for buses

bus_data <- bus_data %>%
  mutate(
    Bound = ifelse(Bound %in% c("N", "S", "E", "W", "NB", "SB", "EB", "WB"),
                   Bound, "Other"),
    Bound = factor(Bound),
    hour = as.integer(format(Time, "%H")),
    peak = ifelse(hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18), 1, 0)
  )

set.seed(348)
idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(bus_data)), size = round(0.8 * nrow(bus_data)))

train <- bus_data[idx, ]
test  <- bus_data[-idx, ]

train <- train %>%
  mutate(hour = as.integer(substr(as.character(Time), 1, 2)))

train_clean <- na.omit(train)

test <- test %>%
  mutate(hour = as.integer(substr(as.character(Time), 1, 2)))

train_clean <- train %>%
  drop_na(`Min Delay`, hour)

model <- lm(`Min Delay` ~ hour, data = train_clean)

yhat_test <- predict(model, newdata = test)
y_test <- test$`Min Delay`
y_test
rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_test - yhat_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
summary(model)
## cause group and delay relationship 
```




```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
### regression
delay_data <- delay_data %>%
  mutate(
    Bound = ifelse(Bound %in% c("N", "S", "E", "W", "NB", "SB", "EB", "WB"),
                   Bound, "Other"),
    Bound = factor(Bound),
    hour = as.integer(format(Time, "%H")),
    peak = ifelse(hour %in% c(7,8,9,16,17,18), 1, 0)
  )

set.seed(348)
idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(delay_data)), size = round(0.8 * nrow(delay_data)))

train <- delay_data[idx, ]
test  <- delay_data[-idx, ]

train <- train %>%
  mutate(hour = as.integer(substr(as.character(Time), 1, 2)))

train_clean <- na.omit(train)

test <- test %>%
  mutate(hour = as.integer(substr(as.character(Time), 1, 2)))

train_clean <- train %>%
  drop_na(`Min Delay`, hour)

model <- lm(`Min Delay` ~ hour, data = train_clean)

yhat_test <- predict(model, newdata = test)
y_test <- test$`Min Delay`
y_test
rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_test - yhat_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
summary(model)
```
